data.name: Faadilah
data.gender_notes: Faadilah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Fadilah’, meaning ‘excellence’, ‘merit’, or ‘virtue’. The name signifies a person who possesses good character and moral values, and is highly regarded in society. The name Faadilah carries the meaning “Excellent, Meritorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faadilah usually hope their child will grow to embody excellent, meritorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of excellence and moral virtues in one's life, as encouraged by Islamic teachings.
data.etymology: Faadilah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Excellent, Meritorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faadilah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
